map.暖气片数量估算器，按房间条件与暖气片类型求热负荷与所需片数，辅助采暖选型。: The radiator count estimator computes the heat load and the number of sections needed from room conditions and radiator type, supporting heating selection.
map.装修定暖气片，按房间面积乘热指标得总 W，再除选中型号单柱 W 得片数并取整。: When specifying radiators for a renovation, multiply room area by the heat index to get total W, then divide by the W per section of the chosen model to get the section count, then round.
map.客餐厅连通大空间按合计面积算，避免分室低估导致整体不热。: A connected open living and dining space is computed on the combined area, to avoid underestimating by splitting rooms and ending up not warm enough.
map.旧房加装对比『加片』与『换大组』，结合接口与美观决策。: For an old house, compare adding sections with replacing them with a larger assembly, and decide based on interfaces and appearance.
map.：面积 35㎡，指标 85W/㎡ → 2975W\n选单柱 130W → 297:
Area 35 sqm, index 85W/sqm -> 2975W
Choose 130W per section -> 2975/130 = about 23 sections (in 2 groups)
map.同主题两种命名，本工具更偏按房间选型；核心是面积×热指标÷单柱散热，结果一致。: Two names for the same topic; this tool leans more toward room-by-room selection, but the core is area x heat index / heat output per section, so the results agree.
map.底层/顶层/边户散热损失大，建议上浮 10%–20%；中间户可按基准。: Top, bottom and end units lose more heat, so add 10%-20%; middle units can use the baseline.
map.片数要取整吗？: Does the Section Count Need Rounding?
map.要。散热器按整柱拼装，向上取整并留余量；过多费热费空间，过少不热。: Yes. Radiators are assembled from whole sections, so round up and leave margin; too many waste heat and space, too few will not warm the room.
